milestones.name: Acquire Dream Nail
milestones.note: Required to reveal and fight Elder Hu's spirit at his memorial

milestones.name: Defeat Elder Hu
milestones.note: Elder Hu shatters and yields 100 Essence collected by the Dream Nail

milestones.name: Collect 100 Essence from Elder Hu
milestones.note: Essence rewarded upon defeating Elder Hu's spirit

milestones.name: Enter Dirtmouth from King's Pass
milestones.note: Initial access to Dirtmouth by breaking down the door at the very end of King's Pass

zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.fingerprintHint: Hub town, contains Elder Hu's memorial above gates to City of Tears

zones.name: King's Pass
zones.fingerprintHint: Entry area leading into Dirtmouth via a breakable door at the very end

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.fingerprintHint: Elder Hu's memorial is located above its gates

zones.name: Mantis Village
zones.fingerprintHint: Location where Elder Hu was killed by the Mantis Tribe

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.fingerprintHint: Mentioned as location context, houses the Love Key corpse

abilities.name: Dream Nail
abilities.grants: Ability to fight spirits of the dead and collect Essence; also allows Dream Nailing interactable corpses for dialogue
abilities.note: Required to initiate fight with Elder Hu and collect his 100 Essence

abilities.name: Shade Cloak
abilities.grants: Dash through attacks including Elder Hu's Ring Slam
abilities.note: Highly recommended but not required for Elder Hu fight

abilities.name: Howling Wraiths
abilities.note: Spell usable in Spell build strategy against Elder Hu

abilities.name: Abyss Shriek
abilities.note: Upgraded spell alternative to Howling Wraiths in Spell build strategy against Elder Hu

abilities.name: Love Key
abilities.note: Held by a large dead Husk Dandy; Dream Nailing the corpse gives dialogue: 'Too long... spent together. We become as one...'

bosses.name: Elder Hu
bosses.note: Spirit of a travelling sage fought at his memorial above the gates to City of Tears. Requires Dream Nail to reveal. Attacks: Ring Slam, Ring Curtain, Teleport. Defeated spirit yields 100 Essence.

objectives.name: Acquire the Dream Nail
objectives.hopDescription: Obtain the Dream Nail to unlock Elder Hu's spirit fight and Essence collection

objectives.name: Fight and defeat Elder Hu at his memorial
objectives.hopDescription: Use the Dream Nail at Elder Hu's memorial above the City of Tears gates; dodge Ring Slam and Ring Curtain attacks using precise movement or Shade Cloak, striking with Nail or Spells in between
objectives.note: Optional Spell build: Shaman Stone, Spell Twister, Soul Catcher, Soul Eater + Howling Wraiths/Abyss Shriek

objectives.name: Collect 100 Essence from Elder Hu
objectives.hopDescription: After defeating Elder Hu, use the Dream Nail to collect the 100 Essence he scatters

objectives.name: Dream Nail the Husk Dandy corpse holding the Love Key
objectives.hopDescription: In Queen's Gardens, Dream Nail the large dead Husk Dandy to receive lore dialogue
objectives.note: Dialogue: 'Too long... spent together. We become as one...'

objectives.name: Enter Dirtmouth via King's Pass
objectives.hopDescription: Break down the door at the very end of King's Pass to access Dirtmouth for the first time

connectors.description: Break down the door at the very end of King's Pass to enter Dirtmouth
connectors.note: Initial and primary early-game access route to Dirtmouth

connectors.description: Elder Hu's memorial is located above the gates to the City of Tears, placing the boss encounter at the boundary between these zones
Elder Hu travelled from Mantis Village where he was slain; his memorial rests in Dirtmouth near City of Tears
